Besides being a student of English linguistics, I love teaching English because I feel I'm like a little seed in my students' knowledge. There isn't something more satisfying than seeing people you help becoming successful in their lives. Furthermore, I have an Instagram page teaching English to Portuguese speakers: @tutor_tami. I'm also interested in sports, trips, movies, music, History, Politics, Economics, and etc.
teacher_info.about_teacher: I've been teaching kids, teenagers and adults from different countries for more than 3 years. So, working with these people helped me to understand some common struggles among students. I assisted these peers mainly with grammar, conversation practice, pronunciation, listening, and accent reduction. Many of my students after some classes became more confident to speak in English. They could understand me and other people, beyond achieving their goals like being admitted at job interviews and different applications.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I always size up the level of English of my students, in order to use appropriate materials with them. I also like when my students give me some suggestions about what we could do in our next class. My lessons are totally fun and useful, focusing on your needs. Whenever the student doesn't know what they need to study while they're not attending my classes, I provide them with a study planner, giving them some tips about what they could study to enhance their skills and become fluent gradually.

pro_course_detail.title: Portuguese Conversation Practice (Prática de Conversação)
pro_course_detail.description:
Vamos começar falando! 
As a language learner myself, I believe that talking is the best and most beautiful way to acquire a language! I'll do my best to provide a safe and respectful environment and we can discuss any topic you like. We can also discuss useful topics on how to express yourself, grammar, and pronunciation.
If you already have some level in Portuguese and would like to start practicing it, book this lesson, I'll be very happy to help 😊

pro_course_detail.title: General Portuguese (Português Geral)
pro_course_detail.description: This one is for beginners who are interested in learning the logic behind the language, with a practical introduction to the basic structures of the language such as Pronouns, Main Verbs, Simple Tenses, Conjugations, how to start expressing yourself, and anything you judge important for your journey!

pro_course_detail.title: Inglês Geral (General English)
pro_course_detail.description: Inglês geral, introdução à gramática simples e básica focada no inglês da vida real, prática de pronúncia, speaking e listening. Apresentação dos pronomes, verbos e palavras importantes. Se você tem já estudou inglês e ainda tem dificuldades em entender essa língua, ou se está começando agora, essa aula é pra você. Vamos aprender a nos expressar de forma contextualizada e simples!

pro_course_detail.title: Prática de Conversação (English Conversation Practice)
pro_course_detail.description: Se você já consegue se comunicar de forma independente ou se tem um nível intermediário - avançado no inglês mas ainda sente algumas dificuldades e tem dúvidas, essa aula é pra você!
